answer: Randomized admission lottery via delay-resistant beacon. Each period, a verifiable delay function emits a seed no one can precompute; agents apply through a fixed window before that seed exists. The seed drives a prism of hash slices assigning applicants to admission slots. Identities whose submissions cluster in one slot are dropped. Because placement depends on the unseen seed, an attacker running many agents must pay full application and compute costs per attempt while facing mesa-like flat admission odds.
